subject: English Comprehension
questionText:
Which part of the following sentence contains a spelling error?

The panellists (1) engaged in a thought-provoking dialogue (2) on post-modern ethics, but one speaker's argumentation (3) lacked coherance (4).
solution:
Part (4) contains the error: "coherance" should be "coherence", meaning the quality of being logical and consistent.

"Panellists" (British spelling), "thought - provoking dialogue" and "argumentation" are correctly spelt.
conceptTested: Identification of misspelled words in a sentence context

questionText: Select the correctly spelt word out of the four alternatives.
solution:
The correct spelling is Hemorrhage: h - e-m - o-rr - h-a - g-e (British spelling: haemorrhage). It means heavy bleeding from a damaged blood vessel.

Hemorage misses one "r" and the "h", Hemmorhage doubles the "m" and has a single "r", and Hemorrhagee adds an extra "e".

subject: English Comprehension
questionText:
Which part of the following sentence contains a spelling error?

The liaison (1) between the two departments ensured effeciency (2) and eliminated unnecessary bureaucracy (3) in the approval process (4).
solution:
Part (2) is misspelt: effeciency should be efficiency.
Pattern: e - ffi - cien - cy (double f followed by i).
Related words: Efficiency: competence, productivity, effectiveness.

subject: English Comprehension
questionText:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

The geology professor explained the formation of ______ rock layers.
solution:
The correct spelling is schistose, meaning having the layered structure of schist rock.

Pattern: s - c-h - i-s - t-o - s-e (single s after "schi").
Related words: Schistose: foliated, laminated, layered.
